messages:
maria_cs: Quick one-pager for customers: day-0 health, lightweight batching/caching/streaming tips, and simple renewal flags. Need quick tech check before publishing.

kevin_eng: Keep it tiny. Recommend defaults: warm_pool=3 KV sessions, client_batch_window=5-20ms, stream_chunk=64 tokens. Call out "sessions" = long-lived KV contexts.

tomi_se: Wording tweak: use 'max_batch_sequence_length' for server-side batch cap. Enterprise accounts should pilot tuning.

liam_sre: Ops pointers: where to find token cost and latency in Console (Observability > Routes). Quick query example: `filter route==\"/generate\" | stats p50(p95) by tenant`. Alert if p95>SLA+150ms for 72h or 5xx/429 spikes >2x.

ashley_pm: Renewal signal add: engagement drop (>30% in 7d) + rising cost per success -> schedule 1:1 and propose model/quantization options. Include 4-line outreach template.

maria_cs: I'll draft the PDF and short internal checklist. Final ask: Eng/SRE sign-off on defaults?

kevin_eng: +1, and add small retry snippet with jitter for streams. Also: validate prefix caching for PII with Security.

tomi_se: +1 for mid-tier defaults. Enterprise = pilot.

maria_cs: Thanks all  I'll publish and notify customers in next onboarding wave.
